Learned advocate for the claimants pointed out the pleadings, evidence, grounds of objection of the appeals as well as the cross objections and the reasons and findings of the learned Reference Court in the impugned judgment.

He submitted to decide these matters on the basis of the earlier judgment delivered by this court in first appeal No. 2367 of 2021 and other connected appeals,

sentences.text:
5. On perusal of the judgment of this Court in first appeal No.
2539 of 2021, decided by this Court on 16.12.2025 and the judgment in first appeal No. 2367 of 2021 and other connected appeals,
decided on 11.03.2026, it would be proper to determine and award the compensation @ Rs.20/- per sq.ft. as the lands in the present matters are acquired for one and the same project and by one and the same notification, even though lands are situated in different villages.
6. In view of the above, the first appeals preferred by the State deserve to be dismissed and the cross objections preferred by the claimants deserve to be allowed.
Hence, the following order:-
ORDER I.
The First appeals are dismissed.
The cross objections are partly allowed.

The impugned judgment and award is set aside and modified as under:-
a) The claimants are entitled to enhanced amount of compensation @ Rs.20/-per sq.ft.
b) The claimants shall not be entitled to receive interest or statutory benefits for the delayed period.
c) The claimants shall be entitled to receive interest under Sections 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as per the judgment of Full Bench of this Court in the case of State of Maharashtra vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari [2016 AIR (Bom) 141].
